{{Top|leg}}{{Quote|Alter is the third and most difficult area to master, for it involves the student's ability to modify the Force and redistribute its energies.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bodo Baas]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:YodaForceLift.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] uses [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to lift [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]].]]
'''Alter''' was a group of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in the teachings of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Regarded as an advanced form of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], it was taught to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] after they had learned the fundamentals of [[Control]] as [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] and [[Sense]] as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. The Alter discipline involved manipulating objects, influencing other beings, and affecting the environment. Many non-trained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] stumbled upon such abilities accidentally, which usually resulted in disastrous events. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] described not progressing to the Alter discipline as being able to perceive the Force but not manipulate it.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

The fundamental Alter techniques were [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], [[Mind trick/Legends|affect mind]], and [[Alter Environment]]. Telekinesis was the core ability which included Force push and Force pull. Affect mind could override the impulses of the weak-minded, and Alter Environment allowed the user to control the natural environment. This could include summoning a whirlwind, lightning, or other natural phenomena.<ref name="The Jedi Path" />
